summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature test for TeamNest.ai Home 'looks'. Verified all 4 Home looks (classic / start / ask / focus) render at /dashboard with the HomeLookSwitcher (data-testid home-look-btn) and persist selection via localStorage key 'tn:tn:home:variant' (safeStorage double-namespaces to 'tn:tn:home:variant'). Verified IntelligenceBanner (data-testid intelligence-banner) at the TOP of ALL FOUR looks, with headline 'Your organization's intelligence shouldn't disappear when people move on.', counts from /api/home/summary (11 saved facts, 4 decisions, 87 research, 7 documents), and CTAs intel-ask-memory, intel-knowledge, intel-role (intel-role visible for super admin sam@funasia.net). Verified HomeComposer routing: single → /my-ai?ask=... redirects to /chats/<personal_ai_id> with data-testid message-input prefilled '@ai Compare pricing of three CRM tools'; compare toggle → prefilled '@ai ask all Best project management approach'. Verified post-login landing helper homeLanding(): variant=ask → /dashboard, variant=focus → /dashboard, variant=classic → /chats (all clean-cookie logins verified). Regression: /my-ai with no query still redirects to personal AI chat. Classic dashboard still renders (data-testid dashboard) with stats, standup quick action, banner, and page-aware TopActionBar (NEW GROUP / NEW FOLDER / DAILY STANDUP visible). Start Center still shows feature cards (start-card-task, start-card-research, etc.) and no longer has the old bottom 'remembers' block (banner moved to top). All target selectors present and clickable. No console errors beyond expected 401s from unauth polling before login.
critical_code_review_comments: homeVariant.js:5 — comment claims new accounts default to 'start', but getHomeVariant defaults to 'classic' unless the account is brand new (created within 7 days). Behavior matches request ('classic default for existing users, non-classic if user chose one'), just noting the code comment on line 3 is slightly misleading vs the actual isBrandNew() check.
MyAI.jsx:16 — .then() has no .catch(); if /chats fetch fails, the user is stuck on the 'Opening your personal AI assistant…' screen with no error. Consider a catch to setErr('Failed to load chats').

context_for_next_testing_agent: The safeStorage key double-namespaces: to force a Home look via localStorage use 'tn:tn:home:variant' (not 'tn:home:variant'). The UI switcher (home-look-btn → home-look-<value>) is the safest way to set variant in tests. Composer prefill lands on /chats/<personal_ai_id>?compose=<encoded> and the target input is data-testid='message-input'. If /logout is used to test post-login landing, it may return to '/' — instead clear cookies via context.clear_cookies() and navigate to /login for a clean re-auth.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this scope.
